Chennai Electric Bus Tender Cancellation Reversed

The Metropolitan Transport Corporation (MTC) in Chennai has revoked its earlier cancellation of a tender for 1,000 electric buses. The initial cancellation had drawn criticism from Anbumani, who slammed the TVK government over the decision.
